segments.name: human capital management
segments.description: Online human capital management platform connecting professionals and corporate customers through recruitment, outsourcing and other services in China.
segments.evidence: As the Company operates businesses as a whole and does not distinguish business line from its subsidiaries, the Company has only one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Corporate customers pay service fees for recruitment and outsourcing, with outsourcing paid on project acceptance.
revenueModel.evidence: Pursuant to the outsourcing service agreement that we sign with the corporate customers, we will receive scheduled payments upon project acceptance and satisfaction of key performance indicators.
